moto_by_hrd: Sambu Group, as a pioneer of the coconut industry in Indonesia, especially in managing human resources, will continue to transform into an industry that is adaptive in various situations. This transformation has been going on for more than 50 years and will continue up to the present time. In this digitalization era, we make this happen by building digital infrastructure in various human resource management functions, creating a safe and comfortable work environment in offices, factories and plantations, as well as providing a place for employees to engage in social activities and join various active and diverse communities.
